keyFindings.description: The interrupt latch misses an interrupt that lands while a prompt is being set up (before agent_start, e.g. during pi-envoy's own before_agent_start Dispatch read, up to 3 s) or during post-prompt recovery outside compaction and retry: the host's abort emits no aborted assistant message there (agent.ts:1554-1556 with no loop running), still sets autoResumeSuppressed (agent-session.ts:10165-10167) and folds the queued card (agent-session.ts:1383-1395, from abort's finally at 10250-10252); runSeq is unchanged, so checkFoldedCards sends the nextTurn+triggerTurn wake and #promptAgentInitiatedMessage starts the turn the person stopped. Contradicts acceptance A3 and CHANGELOG.md:49.

In print/json mode the startup phase's wake can start a turn after initializeExtensions returns while print-mode.ts awaits MCP startup (print-mode.ts:250-254); the initial session.prompt then passes no streamingBehavior and throws AgentBusyError (agent-session.ts:7710-7717). On main the card's turn ran inside the drain and print mode prompted an idle session. The host exposes ctx.mode (extensibility/extensions/types.ts:652-653).

Order-dependent: it imports connect from "nats" (line 15) while envoy.test.ts:197 mock.module("nats") replaces it for the whole Bun process. `bun test ./extensions/envoy.test.ts ./extensions/card-delivery-omp.test.ts` gave 893 pass 8 fail, each 'connection.request is not a function' at card-delivery-omp.test.ts:336; alone it passes 9/9 four times. The package's `bun test` (CI's step) runs both in one process.

Cleanup: the wake subsystem (about 200 lines, seven closure variables at 1670-1711, written from deliver, message_end, auto_compaction_end, auto_retry_end, agent_start, agent_end and three cancelFoldCheck sites) belongs in its own module, as src/agent-stream.ts did, with its policy unit-tested without NATS.

Docs: a host without isIdle still sends a targeted Aside as an aside (envoy.ts:1262), not 'every card a steer' (AGENTS.md:28, CHANGELOG.md:46); a folded targeted Aside gets no wake outside startup (envoy.ts:1821) and a startup targeted Aside does get one, in plan mode too; neither doc says so.
Comment at 1710 says the host timer has no cancel handle; the pinned host's setTimeout returns a Timer and has clearTimer (extensibility/extensions/types.ts:748-750).
The /plan case (660-670) publishes no card and asserts only host behaviour.
isSummarization (50-54) and call() are copies of helpers in dispatch-first-omp.test.ts and legion-role-tools-omp.test.ts; export them from packages/pi-shared/test/omp-harness.ts.
unseenStartupCards.set at 1268 runs after pi.sendMessage and leans on host ordering the comment has to defend; record before the send.
foldedCards and seenStartupCards hold one concept with two rules; one list with a startup flag removes the split.
